findings.quote: dehydrateOptions: { shouldDehydrateQuery: (q) => q.state.status === 'success' && q.meta?.persist !== false }
findings.problem: G4's 1.7a already ships the persistence contract the docs asked for: `packages/db/src/keys.ts` exports `SIGNED_URL_KEY_ROOT = 'signedUrl'` and `shouldPersistQuery(queryKey)` (false for `signedUrl` and `context` keys) and its HANDOFF note says 'step 4.1 passes it as the persister's dehydrateOptions.shouldDehydrateQuery'. 4.1a invents a parallel `meta.persist` contract instead, so two agents (1.7a vs 4.1a/4.2a) produce incompatible mechanisms and the `context` key would be persisted across accounts.
findings.fix: In Build 9 replace the shouldDehydrateQuery line with: `dehydrateOptions: { shouldDehydrateQuery: (q) => q.state.status === 'success' && shouldPersistQuery(q.queryKey) && q.meta?.persist !== false }` importing `shouldPersistQuery` from `@church/db`; add to Inputs: '`@church/db` keys.ts exports `queryKeys.signedUrl(bucket, path)`, `SIGNED_URL_KEY_ROOT` and `shouldPersistQuery(queryKey)` (1.7a) — use them, do not add a parallel key'. In 4.2a drop the sentence 'If `queryKeys` has no signed-URL key, add `queryKeys.signedUrl(bucket, path)` additively…' (the key exists) and keep `meta: { persist: false }` only as belt-and-braces.

findings.quote: Step 1.7a produced `@church/db`: `DbClient`, `Database` (`@church/db/types`), `queryKeys` (`packages/db/src/keys.ts`), `QUERY_STALE_TIME_MS`, `QUERY_GC_TIME_MS`, `SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS`, `SIGNED_URL_CACHE_MS`
findings.problem: Per G4, `SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS` and `SIGNED_URL_CACHE_MS` are exported by `@church/domain` (`src/limits.ts`, step 1.6a), not by `@church/db`. Only `QUERY_STALE_TIME_MS`/`QUERY_GC_TIME_MS`/`shouldPersistQuery` live in `@church/db` keys.ts. An agent importing the signed-URL constants from `@church/db` gets a typecheck failure and may retype the literals (which 4.2a's own Verify forbids).
findings.fix: Change the Inputs bullet to: '`@church/db` (1.7a): `DbClient`, `Database`, `queryKeys`, `QUERY_STALE_TIME_MS`, `QUERY_GC_TIME_MS`, `shouldPersistQuery`, the RPC wrappers and queries. `@church/domain` (1.6a): `SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS = 3600`, `SIGNED_URL_CACHE_MS = 50 * 60 * 1000`, `BUCKETS`, `parseMediaLink`, `readMaxUploadMb`; 1.6b: `APP_SCHEME` in `src/urls.ts`.'

findings.quote: keep `theme.ts` free of React Native imports other than `react-native-paper` types so `app.config.ts` can load it under Node — if that fails, split the raw hex values into `src/theme/tokens.ts`
findings.problem: Build 6 also says `paperTheme` is built from `MD3LightTheme`/`MD3DarkTheme` of `react-native-paper`, which is a runtime import that pulls in `react-native` (Flow/JSX sources Node cannot parse). Loading `src/theme.ts` from `app.config.ts` (evaluated by Expo CLI under Node) and from `src/theme.test.ts` (Vitest node env, Build 1) will therefore fail deterministically; the 'if that fails' fallback means two agents end up with different file layouts (`src/theme.ts` vs `src/theme/tokens.ts`) that 4.1b–4.3 import by name.
findings.fix: Mandate the split now: '`src/theme/tokens.ts` — pure data, no imports: `export const colors = {...}`, `export const brand = { appName: 'Anacast' }`. `src/theme.ts` — `export { colors, brand } from './theme/tokens'` plus `export const paperTheme` built from `react-native-paper`'s `MD3LightTheme`/`MD3DarkTheme`. `app.config.ts` and `src/theme.test.ts` import ONLY `./src/theme/tokens`; screens import `@/theme`.' Update the done_when bullet and 4.1b/4.2a/4.2b Inputs accordingly (they say `src/theme.ts`; keep that as the screen-facing module).

findings.quote: `doctor: expo-doctor`, `export:android: expo export --platform android --output-dir dist`
findings.problem: `expo-doctor` is not listed in dependencies or devDependencies, so the `doctor` script fails (`expo-doctor: command not found`) and 4.4's CI command `pnpm --filter mobile exec expo-doctor` cannot run; 4.4 then hedges with `npx expo-doctor@latest`, which is exactly the unpinned behaviour 4.4 says it wants to avoid.
findings.fix: In Build 1 add `expo-doctor` to devDependencies via `pnpm add -D expo-doctor` (pure JS tool; `npx expo install expo-doctor` is also acceptable) and state 'CI (4.4) runs the repo-pinned `pnpm exec expo-doctor`'. In Verify use `pnpm exec expo-doctor` alongside `npx expo-doctor`. In 4.4 Build 3 delete the 'if `expo-doctor` is not a dependency, `npx expo-doctor@latest` is acceptable' clause.

findings.problem: 4.1a uses nothing from 2.1b (invite page / `inviteDeepLink`); that dependency belongs to 4.1b, which builds `invite/[token]`. 4.1a only mirrors 2.1a's `brand.ts`/`@theme` approach. Over-strict dependency delays the mobile scaffold behind a web step it does not need.
findings.fix: Set 4.1a `depends_on` to `["1.7b", "2.1a"]` and 4.1b `depends_on` to `["4.1a", "2.1b"]`; adjust the notes sentence '`depends_on` uses the split ids… 2.1b (invite web page / `inviteDeepLink`)' to 4.1b.

findings.quote: add a Vitest test in `src/config.test.ts` that imports both and asserts equality
findings.problem: `app.config.ts` exports a function of `ConfigContext`; the prompt does not say how the test obtains the config object, and with the theme import problem above the test fails unless `app.config.ts` imports only `./src/theme/tokens`.
findings.fix: Write: '`src/config.test.ts`: `import config from '../app.config'; const c = config({ config: {}, projectRoot: process.cwd(), staticConfigPath: null, packageJsonPath: null } as ConfigContext); expect(c.scheme).toBe(APP_SCHEME); expect(c.android?.package).toMatch(/^com\.anacast\.app$/i)`' (the second assertion tolerates the founder's casing).

findings.quote: `app/(app)/(tabs)/_layout.tsx` (a real `Tabs` with `home`, `sermons`, `more` and `@expo/vector-icons` icons — this one is final)
findings.problem: 4.1b Build 9 adds a header org-switcher button to the tabs layout and 4.2a Build 3 puts the switcher button in the Home header, so the tabs layout is edited again; 'final' misleads the 4.1a agent into locking it down.
findings.fix: Replace 'this one is final' with 'this one is real, not a placeholder; 4.1b adds the org-switcher header button'.

findings.quote: `git grep -n "anacast://" apps/mobile` → nothing outside a comment or test
findings.problem: `apps/mobile/README.md` (4.1a Build 12, 4.2a/4.2b/4.3 README sections) legitimately documents `anacast://invite/<token>`, so this check produces hits the agent must judge manually; it also does not exercise the intended rule (no hand-rolled scheme strings in code).
findings.fix: Change to `git grep -n "anacast://" apps/mobile/src apps/mobile/app -- ':!*.test.ts'` → nothing (comments excepted); same edit in the done_when bullet.

findings.quote: Use expo-router `Stack.Protected` guards if the installed `expo-router` exposes them (SDK 53+); otherwise the `Redirect` pattern above.
findings.problem: Expo SDK 57's expo-router (~57.0.18, pinned in PLAN §3) always exposes `Stack.Protected`; offering two patterns makes two agents build different gates and leaves `app/index.tsx` logic duplicated with the layout guard.
findings.fix: Pick one: 'Use `Stack.Protected guard={...}` in `app/(app)/_layout.tsx` and `app/(auth)/_layout.tsx` (expo-router 57 has it); keep `app/index.tsx` as the only place that decides the initial destination.' Remove the Redirect alternative from Build 8 and the `Stack.Protected` vs `Redirect` deviation hint in Finish.

findings.quote: constants `SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS` (3600) and `SIGNED_URL_CACHE_MS` (50 min)
findings.problem: Listed under `@church/db` in Inputs, repeated in Constraints ('from `@church/db` only'), in Verify ('constants come from `@church/db`') and in done_when. Per G4 they are exported by `@church/domain` `limits.ts` (1.6a). The agent will hit a missing-export typecheck error on the central hook of the step.
findings.fix: Everywhere in 4.2a (Inputs, Build 1, Constraints, Verify, done_when) change the source of `SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS`/`SIGNED_URL_CACHE_MS` to `@church/domain`; keep `createSignedUrl` and `queryKeys.signedUrl(bucket, path)` under `@church/db`.

findings.quote: `queries/settings.ts` — the org settings reader (read the file for its name; it returns `organization_settings` including `timezone`)
findings.problem: G4 fixes the names: `getSettings(db, orgId)` in `queries/settings.ts`, and `@church/domain` `dates.ts` exports `todayInZone(tz)` and `bulletinPresets`. Leaving them as 'read the file' is unnecessary hedging that invites divergent wrappers.

findings.quote: `FileSystem.getContentUriAsync(localUri)` (or the `File` equivalent)
findings.problem: In SDK 54+ the object API (`File`/`Paths`) does not expose `getContentUriAsync`; it lives in `expo-file-system/legacy`. 'or the File equivalent' sends the agent hunting for a function that may not exist.
findings.fix: Write: 'download with the object API (`new File(Paths.cache, fileName)`, `File.downloadFileAsync`); for the Android content URI import `getContentUriAsync` from `expo-file-system/legacy` (the object API has no equivalent as of SDK 57 — check the installed typings and record which you used).'

findings.quote: Read `packages/domain/src/media-links.ts` and `src/urls.ts` to see how the hosted YouTube embed URL is built (1.6b added a builder for `/embed/yt/<id>`)
findings.problem: G4's 1.6b fixes the builder: `youtubeHostedEmbedUrl(appUrl, id)` = `appUrl + youtubeHostedEmbedPath(id)` in `packages/domain/src/urls.ts`, trailing slash trimmed, and names 'G11 4.2 WebView' as a consumer. The prompt's 'read the file / add it if missing' hedge and the open_issue are resolvable now; naming it prevents an agent from adding a duplicate builder.
findings.fix: In Inputs write: '`@church/domain` `src/urls.ts` (1.6b): `youtubeHostedEmbedUrl(appUrl, videoId)` → `${appUrl}/embed/yt/${videoId}` (trailing slash trimmed) and `youtubeHostedEmbedPath(videoId)`.' In Build 7 write `hostedEmbedUrl = youtubeHostedEmbedUrl(publicEnv().webUrl, videoId)`. Delete the 'if the builder does not exist, add it' sentence from notes and remove the corresponding open_issue.

findings.quote: `media_kind ('upload' | youtube | dropbox | gdrive | other — read the enum)`
findings.problem: G2's `media_kind` enum is `upload, youtube, dropbox, google_drive, url`. Wrong literals in the prompt risk a wrong `resolvePlayer` switch and wrong test fixtures even though the agent is told to read the enum.
findings.fix: Replace with `media_kind` (`upload | youtube | dropbox | google_drive | url` — the `media_kind` enum from 1.2).

findings.quote: No background audio for YouTube (ToS) — say so in a one-line caption when the app is backgrounded? No: just do not request it.
findings.problem: Drafting self-dialogue left in the prompt; an executing agent cannot tell whether a caption is wanted.

findings.quote: Tests (Vitest, node, `vi.mock` for `expo-notifications`, `expo-device`, `expo-constants`)
findings.problem: `src/lib/push.ts` imports `Platform` from `react-native` and `@church/db` helpers; in a node Vitest run `react-native` cannot be parsed, so the `registerForPush` state-machine test fails unless `react-native` and the `supabase` module are mocked too.

findings.quote: a second grep for the old placeholder package id that PLAN §9 lists

findings.quote: use `python3 -c "import yaml,sys; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/ci.yml'))"`

findings.quote: `EAS_PROJECT_ID` (plaintext)
findings.problem: EAS reserves the `EAS_` prefix for built-in build variables and may reject creating a user variable named `EAS_PROJECT_ID` (`eas env:create`). The name comes from PLAN §9/DESIGN §10 so it must stay the default, but the docs step should tell the founder what to do if EAS refuses it, otherwise 4.5 stalls.
findings.fix: Add to Build 1.4 and the troubleshooting list: 'If EAS rejects the name `EAS_PROJECT_ID` (reserved prefix), rename the variable to `EXPO_PUBLIC_EAS_PROJECT_ID` in `app.config.ts`, `.env.example`, `docs/ENV.md` and this document together, and record the deviation in HANDOFF.' The same note belongs in 4.5 item 8.

findings.quote: on the web, `/o/<slug>/users` → Create account or Invite yourself (Checkpoint B created the church; if you are only the super admin, add yourself as a member now)
findings.problem: The founder's email already has an auth account (super admin sign-up in 2.5). `Create account` (`createUserDirect` → `auth.admin.createUser`) fails for an existing email, so only the Invite path works, and the invitation must then be accepted (web `/invite/<token>` while signed in with that email, or in the app). The checklist offers a dead path first and omits the accept step.
findings.fix: Replace item 2 with: 'You are an **active member** of the first church with the email you will type into the phone. Because that email already has an account, use `/o/<slug>/users` → **Invite** (not Create account) with your own email, then open the invite link on the web while signed in and accept it (or accept it later in the app via the `anacast://invite/<token>` "Open in app" button). Confirm `/o/<slug>/users` lists you as active. The Supabase Free project must not be paused…'

findings.quote: lock the phone → audio keeps playing and the lock screen shows the title
findings.problem: 4.2b explicitly allows shipping without lock-screen metadata ('lock-screen controls pending expo-audio API' recorded under Deviations); the checklist then fails on a known, documented gap.
findings.fix: Append: '(if HANDOFF 'Deviations from plan' says lock-screen controls are pending, expect the audio to continue but no title on the lock screen — record it, do not count it as a failure)'. Mirror in done_when bullet 5.

findings.quote: `npx eas-cli init` → confirm creating the project under your account (slug `anacast`). Because `app.config.ts` is dynamic, EAS prints the project id instead of writing it
findings.problem: `eas init` on a dynamic config prints an instruction to add `extra.eas.projectId` and may exit non-zero until the id is present; the founder is not told that the subsequent `npx eas-cli project:info` and `build` only work after `apps/mobile/.env` contains `EAS_PROJECT_ID=<id>` (Expo CLI loads `.env` when evaluating `app.config.ts`).
findings.fix: Add after item 6: 'Create `apps/mobile/.env` from `.env.example` and set `EAS_PROJECT_ID=<id>` (plus the three `EXPO_PUBLIC_*` values for local runs); re-run `npx eas-cli init` (it now finds the id and links the project) before item 7.'
